title: BR-22b · copy (one-off CP-01 leg)
line: Two for one, so you do both knees, which is what she needed. Sixty days, and you keep the straps. From the Stryde site. The copies stretch, and a stretched strap stops holding the spot.
notes: a stretched grey near-copy strap sags down a shin · one slow sag, 2s · L-P-KITCH · P-D2 · low/profile/CU — low + profile = the sag · pip · EG02 · EG01 · product: near-copy (FAKE_BASE) · F7
